C04: Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; AX roles, names, focus and live status regions are inspected.

C05: Academy is a local synthetic endpoint answering Academy's learner procedures with synthetic catalog content shaped after Academy's routers at the pinned commit; hosted Academy is qualified in C25 (L11).
C05: Browser approval is simulated by the synthetic token endpoint; the fixture build records pages instead of launching a browser.

C05: Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; AX roles, names, focus and live status regions are inspected. Screen capture is not available to this session, so themes are checked through AX text colors.

C06: Academy is a local synthetic endpoint answering Academy's learner procedures with synthetic coursework shaped after Academy's routers at the pinned commit; hosted Academy (timing, grading, awards) is qualified in C25 (L13).
C06: The fixture build records print sheets and browser pages instead of opening them; the native print sheet itself is not driven.
C06: The identity practical is reached from identity-course pages the synthetic catalog does not carry; its assessor gating is covered by the route sweep and Academy's own tests, not natively.

C06: The fixture build answers the avatar picker with an image the driver stages in its data root, and records instead of opening the print sheet; the native NSOpenPanel and print sheet are not driven.
C06: Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; AX roles, names, focus and live regions are inspected.

C07: Academy is a local synthetic endpoint answering Academy's offline contract (desktop.access, desktop.bundle, desktop.manifest, desktop.unitBundle) with synthetic coursework shaped after Academy's routers at the pinned commit; hosted Academy is qualified in C25 (L13).
